title: Max Split of Positive Even Integers

monster.name: Even Splitting Fiend
monster.title: Divider into Distinct Even Addends
monster.defeatQuote: FinalSum decomposed into maximum count of unique even integers!

description: You are given an integer `finalSum`. Split it into a sum of a maximum number of unique positive even integers. Return a list of integers that represent a valid split, or `[]` if impossible.
solutionCode:
def maximumEvenSplit(finalSum: int) -> list[int]:
    if finalSum % 2 == 1: return []
    res = []
    curr = 2
    while finalSum >= curr:
        res.append(curr)
        finalSum -= curr
        curr += 2
    res[-1] += finalSum
    return res
hints: Greedily take smallest even numbers 2, 4, 6, ... and add remaining surplus to the last number.
